title: Update our Logray icons.
description:
Enlarge the left fin, which makes the 16x16 blob look a little better.
Shorten the tail.

notes.body:
added 1 commit

[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/8454/diffs?diff_id=503844618&start_sha=4f1777ec34523a1eee17636178c53ad912555319)
enabled an automatic merge when the pipeline for 3b074f73441a3357ce1d250b8169dcde9bd8b285 succeeds
